proposals.evidence: Turner 2462 §2 gives Sindhi heko “unique”, Lahnda hikk and Punjabi hik- “single” under *ēkka-, the reinforced branch of ḗka. Grierson Khetrani hik “One” fits the regional h-k form; the chosen second subsection distinguishes it from unsuffixed ḗka. Exact LSI digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

proposals.evidence: Turner 6227 gives Sindhi ḍ̠aha and Lahnda ḍ̠ā̆h “ten” under dáśa; the LSI digital Khetrani row prints ḍḍāh, with doubled initial retroflex. Turner elsewhere lists Khetrani dā, so the printed spelling is anomalous, but the numeral sense and regional ḍ-h shape support the family. No transcription emendation is made; physical scan recheck remains pending. Exact LSI digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.
